legendContract.description: Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 1.50, 1.34 and 0.73–0.74 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.

visibleDescriptionAndLegend.text:
Galileo NIMS spectral color

Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 1.50, 1.34 and 0.73–0.74 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.
